hints.title: Permutation Invariance
hints.text: Arbitrary adjacent swaps allow moving all ones to any desired subset of positions in the array.

hints.title: Count Total Ones
hints.text: Count the number of set bits c = s.count('1').

hints.title: Greedy Top Values
hints.text: To maximize total score, place the c ones at the positions with the c largest values in the values array.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating individual swap moves is unnecessary and computationally intractable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorts in place requiring O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects realizing full permutation freedom under unlimited adjacent swaps.
